name: Sheva (High Priest)
title: Jewish High Priest in Ephesus
summary: Sheva was a Jewish high priest in Ephesus who had seven sons. His sons attempted to cast out evil spirits by using the name of Jesus without having a personal relationship with him, which ended catastrophically and demonstrated that spiritual authority cannot be imitated.

keyEvents.title: The Sons' Failed Exorcism
keyEvents.description: Sheva's seven sons tried to cast out an evil spirit by invoking the names of Jesus and Paul, but the evil spirit replied that it knew Jesus and knew about Paul, but not them.

keyEvents.title: The Evil Spirit's Attack
keyEvents.description: The man possessed by the evil spirit overpowered all seven brothers, beat them, and tore off their clothes, causing them to flee naked and wounded from the house.

keyEvents.title: The Impact of the Event in Ephesus
keyEvents.description: This event became known to everyone in Ephesus, both Jews and Greeks, leading to fear coming upon them and the name of the Lord Jesus being honored.

keyEvents.title: Spiritual Revival Follows
keyEvents.description: As a result of this event, many believers came forward and confessed their sins, and many who had practiced sorcery burned their books publicly.
